================================================================================
   MIGRATION STEPS TO NEW RASPBERRY PI
================================================================================

1. Insert Lexar USB stick into new Raspberry Pi
2. Copy backup folder:
   cp -r /media/pi/Lexar/RDK_Device_Manager_Backup_* ~/
3. Navigate to folder:
   cd ~/RDK_Device_Manager_Backup_*
4. Run installation:
   chmod +x install_complete_system.sh
   ./install_complete_system.sh
5. Deploy application:
   cp -r app/* ./
   cp config/* ./
   cp data/* ./
6. Start application:
   source venv/bin/activate
   python3 app.py

Total time: ~10-15 minutes

================================================================================
   WHAT'S NOT INCLUDED
================================================================================

The following are NOT backed up (not needed for fresh install):
- venv/ (virtual environment - will be created by installer)
- __pycache__/ (Python cache - automatically regenerated)
- screenshots/ (captured screenshots - device-specific)
- iteration_logs/ (execution logs - will be created new)
- base_images/ (baseline images - can be recaptured)
- *.pyc files (compiled Python - automatically regenerated)
- .backup files (temporary backups)

These will be created automatically during installation and usage.

================================================================================
   IMPORTANT NOTES
================================================================================

⚠️  SECURITY:
   - devices.json contains SSH passwords in plain text
   - users.json contains hashed passwords
   - Protect these files appropriately
   - Change default admin password after installation

⚠️  NETWORK CONFIGURATION:
   - Update device IP addresses in devices.json for new network
   - Default SSH port is 10022
   - Application runs on port 5000 (HTTP) or 5443 (HTTPS)

⚠️  POST-INSTALLATION:
   - Test SSH connectivity to each device
   - Verify Tesseract OCR installation
   - Check screenshot capture functionality
   - Run a simple test method to verify setup
